text:
Country famous for the Great Barrier Reef: Australia

Actionable items from the email:

1. Task: Gather all necessary data from each department.
   Deadline: End of the month (implied, as the report is due then).

2. Task: Compile the statistics.
   Deadline: End of the month.

3. Task: Draft the annual report.
   Deadline: End of the month.

4. Task: Send the draft report for review.
   Deadline: By the 25th.

5. Response Request: Implicitly, the recipient needs to confirm they will meet the deadline of sending the draft by the 25th.
